issues.issue: Whether the officer's decision was reasonable regarding the evidence of employment offer.
issues.applicant_position: LMIA approval letter was sufficient evidence of a qualifying offer.
issues.respondent_position: LMIA is not determinative; the applicant was advised to include a signed job offer; the approval letter does not constitute an offer.
issues.result_text: The officer reasonably required a proper offer letter; the decision was within an acceptable range.

issues.issue: Whether the applicant was procedurally unfair because his application was refused rather than returned as incomplete.
issues.applicant_position: Expected that incomplete applications would be returned, based on manual and previous practice.
issues.respondent_position: Application was complete but evidence was insufficient; legitimate expectations do not apply.
issues.result_text: Application was complete; the doctrine of legitimate expectations does not apply.

issues.issue: Whether the decision under review was made in accordance with applicable law and policy.
issues.respondent_position: Decision was made based on the IRPA and IRP Regulations, requiring a valid offer of employment.
issues.result_text: The decision complied with legal requirements; the officer reasonably required a proper offer letter.
